workItem: Remove the authenticated dashboard first-render freeze by separating non-active routed feature graphs and heavyweight below-the-fold modules from the critical dashboard mount path.
workItemDE: Freeze beim ersten Aufruf des authentifizierten Dashboards durch progressive Modulgrenzen und bedarfsgesteuertes Laden beseitigen.
projectStage: cross-cutting presentation/performance; no productive PVC ownership
priorityReason: Fresh Human Owner runtime report: Gmail registration succeeds, but entering the Dashboard freezes the page.
scopeBoundary: No scoring, data, entitlement, Stripe, IAM or provider semantics change.
Dashboard navigation and visible component contracts remain unchanged; only loading/evaluation timing is changed.
No direct main mutation or deployment mutation.

evidence.ownerDirection: Fresh owner report in the active conversation.
evidence.openWriterOverlap: PASS: open PRs #1363, #1364 and #1365 have no changed-file overlap with the dashboard/auth frontend slice.

DashboardHome simultaneously mounts crypto research, news, PDF/compliance, sentiment and image-analysis surfaces.

acceptanceCriteria: The /dashboard shell can render without eagerly evaluating DashboardViewRouter or MyWorkspace feature graphs.
DashboardViewRouter is mounted only for routed detail views.
Default dashboard heavyweight sections are split behind lazy/progressive boundaries with stable loading fallbacks.
Authenticated backend-cookie session and subscription readback semantics remain unchanged.
Regression test proves the eager feature-barrel path cannot be reintroduced in Dashboard/DashboardHome.
TypeScript/unit/build and required PR checks pass on the exact head.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession, or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
